tools_helpful.evidence: session-log: 'Rewrote Windows.UI.Xaml -> Microsoft.UI.Xaml' handled the bulk Xaml namespace moves so the ported MainPage/scenario code compiled against Microsoft.UI.Xaml.*
build-output.txt: 'BUILD SUCCEEDED' after the color/DataTemplate fixes; final score 100/100 with 0 warnings/0 errors.

tool_limitations.limitation: The mass-rewrite only maps 'Windows.UI.Xaml' -> 'Microsoft.UI.Xaml'. It does NOT rewrite the non-Xaml framework types that also relocated to Microsoft.UI (Windows.UI.Colors, Windows.UI.ColorHelper), so ported code still referencing them fails to compile.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Extend the bootstrap rewrite to also map Windows.UI.Colors/ColorHelper -> Microsoft.UI.* using a trailing word boundary so the Windows.UI.Color struct (which stays) is preserved.

failed_apis.why_tried: Ported UWP code set StatusBorder.Background = new SolidColorBrush(Windows.UI.Colors.Green/Red).
failed_apis.root_cause: In WinApp SDK the Colors class moved from the Windows.UI namespace to Microsoft.UI; only the Windows.UI.Color struct stayed. Bootstrap did not rewrite it.

failed_apis.why_tried: Ported UWP ListBox ItemTemplate used compiled binding.
failed_apis.root_cause: XAML compiler emitted WMC0909 'Cannot resolve DataType local:Scenario' + WMC1111 + an internal WMC9999.
failed_apis.fix: Switched the DataTemplate to classic {Binding Title} (no x:DataType).

special_apis.special_handling: These moved to Microsoft.UI.* in WinApp SDK, but the Windows.UI.Color struct (and Point/Size/Rect) did NOT — a naive Windows.UI->Microsoft.UI replace is wrong; only the helper classes move.

errors_encountered.error: CS0234: The type or namespace name 'Colors' does not exist in the namespace 'Windows.UI' (MainPage.xaml.cs lines 110,113)
errors_encountered.root_cause: Windows.UI.Colors relocated to Microsoft.UI.Colors; bootstrap namespace rewrite covers only Windows.UI.Xaml.

errors_encountered.error: XamlCompiler WMC0909 'Cannot resolve DataType local:Scenario' + WMC1111 + WMC9999 (MainPage.xaml lines 25-26)
errors_encountered.root_cause: x:Bind DataTemplate could not resolve the x:DataType at XAML-compile time.

dev_agent_struggles.where: First dotnet build of the ported MainPage
dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Build failed with CS0234 (Windows.UI.Colors) and XamlCompiler WMC0909/WMC1111/WMC9999 (DataTemplate x:DataType).
dev_agent_struggles.turns_or_retries: 1 failed build -> targeted fixes -> clean build
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Ported UWP code kept Windows.UI.Colors (a moved-but-unrewritten type) and an x:Bind DataTemplate whose x:DataType didn't resolve.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Rewrote Windows.UI.Colors -> Colors and DataTemplate x:Bind -> {Binding}.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Extending Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1's namespace mass-rewrite to also map the moved non-Xaml Windows.UI helper classes (Colors/ColorHelper) to Microsoft.UI, plus a validator residue rule as backstop.

env_issues.issue: WinUI 3 client-area screenshots captured blank white in the headless session (GetForegroundWindow=0).
env_issues.workaround: Parity was verified behaviorally via UI Automation actuation; this is a capture-environment limit, not a migration defect.
